The league season had two champions, with [[Boca Juniors]] winning the Apertura (22nd league title for the club), while [[Club Atlético Vélez Sársfield|Vélez Sársfield]] won the Clausura championship (2nd league title). [[Club Atlético Lanús|Lanús]] (as champion of [[1991–92 Primera B Nacional]]) and [[San Martín de Tucumán]] (winner of "Torneo Dodecagonal""Argentina: 1ra. "B" Nacional AFA 1991/92 - Torneo Dodecagonal por el 2do. Ascenso" by José Carluccio, 21 Jan 2012 after beating [[Club Almirante Brown|Almirante Brown]] in a two-legged series)[https://www.elgrafico.com.ar/articulo/1088/34222/1992-otra-proeza-de-san-martin 1992. Otra proeza de San Martin] on ''El Gráfico'', 26 Jul 2019 were the teams promoted from the [[Primera B Nacional]] (second division). On the other hand, [[Talleres de Córdoba]] and San Martín de Tucumán were related to [[Primera Nacional|Primera B Nacional]].[https://www.rsssf.org/tablesa/arg93.html Argentina 1992/93] on the RSSSF"Argentina: 1ra.
